name: Hyoudou Makina
source: The principal of Meiryo Academy. An elite who skipped grades while studying education abroad, she possesses a confidence and dignity that belies her youth. She inherits the methods of her father, who established his own standing by producing outstanding students and building connections in various fields. Her actions have become even more radical, making her the academy's queen, who views the students merely as pawns.
